basic_details.job_title: SBC Exports Scientific Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: M/s. SBC Exports Ltd., a private outsourcing agency supplying manpower to Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre (HBCH&RC), Muzaffarpur on contract basis, will hold a walk-in interview on 23 November 2026 (between 09.00 am and 10.00 am) for 1 post of Scientific Assistant (Radiodiagnosis) at a monthly remuneration of Rs. 30,000/-. Outstation candidates may request an online interview by email to [email protected], and the request must be received by 20 November 2026 up to 3:00 p.m.

content_sections.heading: About SBC Exports
content_sections.text: M/s. SBC Exports Ltd. describes itself in the notice as an outsourcing agency for the supply of manpower services to HBCH&RC, Muzaffarpur on contract basis. The post is therefore a contract engagement through this private agency, not a direct government appointment. The posting is at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Shri Krishna Medical College and Hospital Campus, Umanagar, Muzaffarpur, Bihar.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates who can come in person attend the walk-in interview at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Shri Krishna Medical College and Hospital Campus, Umanagar, Muzaffarpur (Bihar) – 842004, on 23.11.2026 between 09.00 am and 10.00 am. Outstation candidates may attend the interview online. For this they send an email to [email protected] , in which: The subject line mentions the post applied for. The resume and supporting documents (Educational Certificates, Experience Certificates and copy of Aadhar and PAN Card) are sent together in a single PDF file. The email is received by 20.11.2026 up to 3:00 p.m. The notice prints no application form.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: B.Sc. (Radiological Imaging Technology) from a recognized University with 50% marks; OR B.Sc. in any subject / B. Pharmacy with 50% marks and minimum two years' Diploma in Medical Imaging Technology from State Board of Technical Education OR any equivalent recognized Board / University. Minimum 01 year internship / experience from a large hospital with experience in CT and MRI. 30 years. The table heading in the notice reads "Age limit as on Walk-In-Interview date". The notice prints no age relaxation. The appointment is initially for a period of six months and extendable, if required. The engagement is on contract basis through M/s. SBC Exports Ltd. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

rows.pay: Rs. 30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand only) monthly remuneration

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: For the walk-in interview, candidates carry: Bio-data Recent passport size photograph PAN Card Aadhar Card Educational and Experience Certificates in original and one set of self-attested copies For the online interview request, the email carries the resume, Educational Certificates, Experience Certificates and a copy of the Aadhar and PAN Card in a single PDF file.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through an interview, either the walk-in interview or the online interview. Candidates may attend the interview in person on 23.11.2026. Outstation candidates may attend online. Only shortlisted candidates who fulfil the norms will be contacted for the online interview. The notice does not describe the interview in more detail.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Accommodation will not be provided to outstation candidates. Outstation candidates who want the online interview must name the post in the email subject line. Only shortlisted candidates who fulfil the norms will be contacted for the online interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the SBC Exports recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, for the post of Scientific Assistant (Radiodiagnosis) at HBCH&RC, Muzaffarpur.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the online interview request?
faq.answer: The email requesting an online interview must be received by 20.11.2026 up to 3:00 p.m. at [email protected].

faq.question: Q3. When and where is the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: It is on 23.11.2026 between 09.00 am and 10.00 am at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Shri Krishna Medical College and Hospital Campus, Umanagar, Muzaffarpur (Bihar) – 842004.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Scientific Assistant (Radiodiagnosis)?
faq.answer: B.Sc. (Radiological Imaging Technology) from a recognized University with 50% marks, OR B.Sc. in any subject / B. Pharmacy with 50% marks and minimum two years' Diploma in Medical Imaging Technology. A minimum of 01 year internship / experience from a large hospital with experience in CT and MRI is also required.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 30 years, as printed under the heading "Age limit as on Walk-In-Interview date".

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this post?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration is Rs. 30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand only).

faq.question: Q7. Can outstation candidates attend the interview online?
faq.answer: Yes, outstation candidates may attend online. They email their resume and documents in a single PDF file to [email protected], mentioning the post in the subject line, by 20.11.2026 up to 3:00 p.m.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should candidates bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bio-data, a recent passport size photograph, PAN Card, Aadhar Card, and Educational and Experience Certificates in original with one set of self-attested copies.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is on contract basis through M/s. SBC Exports Ltd., an outsourcing agency. The appointment is initially for six months and extendable, if required.

faq.answer: No, the notice states that accommodation will not be provided to outstation candidates.
